title: Bilateral middle-trial grip excursions did not establish added glycemic prediction across separate NHANES samples
abstract: Bilateral middle-trial grip-excursion concordance did not establish incremental HbA1c prediction beyond maximum strength, asymmetry and marginal dynamics: source CV MSE gain -0.001684 percentage-points²; separate-sample target gain 0.002746 (400 source+target PSU-refit 95% interval -0.010006 to 0.011596). Same-program independent-sample testing, not untouched external-cohort confirmation or equivalence.
